$Comment: The luck-tier T4 find table (SawmillLuckTiers' fourth tier: luck sum 200 or higher and WOODCUTTING 60 or higher): 30 percent for 5 to 7 life essence, plus 10 percent for 2 to 3 CONCENTRATED life essence, else nothing. Weights sum to 100 (60 empty), so a T4 roll pays something 40 percent of the time and the concentrated jackpot is now a real, repeatable payout rather than T3's single-unit rarity. A find is deliberately a DIFFERENT item from the cycle's own planks - extra planks are Grants.OutputItems' concern. Every weight and quantity here is initial balance and tunable.
